title: simulation result.json contract
description: Complete contract for <module>/Verification/simulation/result.json. On status=fail, stage_specific.fail_reason is required (if/then below): the one-line failure narrative, absent on pass, and the only thing that says which sub-step tripped. Companions ride along when the reaped verify verdict held them — failing_cases on a smoke/regress failure, the two gap lists on a Rule-B route-out. Only routing-relevant fields are enumerated below; informational fields (total_cases, coverage_summary, etc.) live free under additionalProperties.

fix_owner.description: Repair stage supported by the evidence: this stage or a transitive input producer, checked by the scheduler. Omit when attribution is unresolved.

failing_cases.description: Failed testcase identifiers and diagnostics for simulation-triage.

log_snippet.description: Optional: the tail around the first UVM_ERROR / UVM_FATAL. Triage falls back to the full per-case log when it is absent or truncated.
